description: This file defines the GroupService interface, which declares methods for managing groups within the application, such as listing groups by type or by IDs.

classes.name: GroupService
classes.description: Interface extending the generic entity service to manage Group entities with additional methods specific to Group management.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by the specified GroupType, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects specified by a set of IDs, may throw ServiceException.
